li.label: Envoys on the horizon
li.text: The ash storm from the Second Awakening has barely settled, yet every long-range radio in {COLONY} is overwhelmed by encrypted hails. Envoys from across the wasteland are converging on your waystation, demanding to know where your settlement stands now that the Spark Resonator blueprints are in your hands.

li.label: Point of No Return: The Declaration
li.text: The waystation hall is packed to the walls—hunters, Brotherhood paladins, Railroad couriers, Vault-Tec clerks, and veiled figures smelling of ozone and sulfur all watch your every move.\n\n{GIVER} steps beside you, speaking quietly: "There's no hiding in the middle anymore. Whatever you declare tonight will split this entire region into armed camps—and force dissenters inside every faction to choose whether to follow their leaders or break ranks for you."

li.label: Declaration of Protection: Shield the Sparks and seal the Rift forever
li.resultText: Your voice rings across the hall and out over every open radio band: {COLONY} will protect the living Sparks of synths and seal the Rift against all invaders. Cheers erupt from the Railroad and Minutemen, while Enclave, Institute, and infernal envoys walk out in icy silence.

li.label: Declaration of Purification: Cleanse the wasteland of anomalies, mutations, and occult parasites
li.resultText: You declare that humanity must reclaim Earth with steel and fire, purging anomalies, mutants, and rogue machines alike. Brotherhood and Enclave officers nod in grim approval, while ghouls, mutants, and Railroad agents vanish into the night.

li.label: Declaration of Higher Order: Entrust the Anchor to celestial and institutional architects
li.resultText: You announce that chaos can only end under strict higher governance, offering the Anchor's power to Heaven's host and the pre-war institutional order. Celestial envoys and Men of Letters operatives incline their heads, while surface rebels vow resistance.

li.label: Declaration of the Abyss: Shatter the Cage and open the gates of Hell
li.resultText: The lights flicker crimson as you proclaim that the old world's barrier will burn—and its harvest of Sparks will feed the lords of Hell and the nocturnal clans. Demons smile darkly in the corners of the room while hunters draw weapons and retreat.

li.label: Declaration of the Abyss: Seize the power of the Pit and rewrite the wasteland
li.resultText: Fulfilling your darkest ambition, you declare that {COLONY} will tear down the celestial barrier and harness the infernal tide. Smoke coils along the floorboards as demons bow in mock reverence and hunters vow vengeance.

li.label: The Cold War Begins
li.text: Your declaration has echoed across every corner of the wasteland. Factions have drawn their battle lines—expect covert spies in your waystation, sabotage at your gates, and secret transmissions from dissenters ready to defect to your banner.

li.label: Unusual guests
li.text: Following your declaration, two impeccably polite "antiquities merchants" check into your waystation—carrying heavy brass luggage that emits a faint Enochian hum whenever they walk past the Zero Anchor hatch.

li.label: Caught red-handed
li.text: Your investigators corner Mr. Kendricks in the lower corridor just as he tries to attach a Consortium triangulation beacon to the Anchor's structural beam. Calmly adjusting his cuffs, he offers a cold smile: "Clever. Now, what do you intend to do with a guest?"

li.label: Reprogram his beacon to feed false coordinates to London and the Consortium
li.resultText: Your engineers quietly alter the transmitter's harmonic offset. Kendricks departs believing his mission succeeded, buying {COLONY} precious breathing room.

li.label: Confiscate his silver wards and interrogate him for Consortium patrol routes
li.resultText: Stripped of his concealed gadgets, Kendricks lets slip the location of an auxiliary Consortium chemical cache before escaping through a smoke screen.

li.label: Throw him out at gunpoint as a warning to all spies
li.resultText: Your guards march the operative out the front gate in full view of passing caravans. The Zero Synth nods approvingly at your vigilance.

li.label: Nervous drifters
li.text: Following your hardline declaration, two twitchy "rail-line prospectors" rent a room at your waystation, spending every night whispering to the Zero Synth and sketching your turret blind spots.

li.label: Intercepted at the bulkhead
li.text: Your security team catches Tinker Tom trying to slip an encrypted extraction holotape to the Zero Synth near the Anchor bulkhead. He raises his hands hastily: "Whoa, easy! We just wanted to make sure the kid had an exit plan before you hook 'em up to that machine!"

li.label: Let him leave quietly after taking his scrambler module
li.resultText: Tinker Tom drops his jury-rigged signal scrambler and bolts into the fog, muttering under his breath. The Zero Synth watches him go with conflicted eyes.

li.label: Confiscate his Railroad cipher keys and interrogate him
li.resultText: You strip the agent of his coded maps and silver stash before escorting him beyond your perimeter.

li.label: Publicly denounce the Railroad infiltrator and tighten security
li.resultText: Your stern crackdown impresses your authoritarian allies, though the Zero Synth grows noticeably colder toward your guards.

li.label: Blinding flash on the perimeter
li.text: A deafening blast rocks the outer perimeter of {COLONY} at dusk! Hostile sappers planted a shaped charge against your auxiliary power relay and vanished, pinning a taunting note to the scorched concrete: "Your walls won't hold when the real storm hits."

li.label: Assessing the breach
li.text: Smoke billows from the damaged junction box while distant motion sensors pick up a hired mercenary strike force moving in to exploit the chaos. How do you respond?

li.label: Reverse-trace the detonator signal to spot the incoming raiders early
li.resultText: Your comms officer locks onto the sappers' short-range burst frequency, giving your defenders clear warning of the incoming assault vector.

li.label: Reroute emergency capacitors and brace the inner barricades
li.resultText: Your mechanics bypass the fried relays in record time, restoring full power to your defenses just as gunfire erupts at the edge of the map.

li.label: Saboteurs routed
li.text: Your defenders crushed the mercenary strike team sent to exploit the sabotage. On the squad leader's body, you found an anonymous contract paid in pre-war bullion.

li.label: Costly skirmish
li.text: Though the raiders eventually withdrew into the ash, the sabotage hit your stockpiles hard—proving your enemies will stop at nothing.

li.label: Stasis signatures closing in
li.text: The Zero Synth clutches their head as a sharp pulse cuts through their thoughts: "They're coming to put me in a stasis cage! I can feel their quantum dampeners locking onto my Spark!"

li.label: Abduction team wiped out
li.text: Your garrison intercepted the Courser extraction team before they could reach the Zero Synth, shattering their stasis shackles and securing the colony!

li.label: The Zero Synth has been taken!
li.text: In the chaos of the assault, X6-88's extraction squad clamped a stasis collar onto the Zero Synth and retreated to a forward relay bunker! Launch a rescue strike immediately!

li.label: Zero Synth rescued!
li.text: Your strike team breached the forward bunker, cut the stasis collar off the Zero Synth, and brought them home safely!

li.label: A desperate self-escape
li.text: Before the captors could complete their final teleport, the Zero Synth overloaded their own stasis collar in a violent Spark surge, limping back to {COLONY} bruised and bitter that no rescue came.

li.label: Battered return
li.text: Though your initial assault faltered, passing Railroad scouts ambushed the weakened transport and escorted the shaken Zero Synth back to {COLONY}.

li.label: Aftermath of the raid
li.text: With the Zero Synth back inside {COLONY}'s walls and the enemy's stasis equipment lying in pieces, one truth is unmistakable: you need the Borax countermeasure and the Spark Resonator completed before the entire wasteland descends on your doorstep.

li.label: Sit with the Zero Synth and reinforce the personal wards around their quarters
li.resultText: The Zero Synth nods slowly, gripping your hand. "I'm ready. Let's reach out to our allies and finish building the Resonator."

li.label: Strip the enemy stasis collars for spare components and double the watch
li.resultText: Your engineers salvage high-grade electronics from the captured shackles while guards lock down every perimeter gate.

TurboMegaMod.StoryQuestDef.label: secret letters: steel and silicon
TurboMegaMod.StoryQuestDef.letterLabel: Encrypted signal from inside the lines
TurboMegaMod.StoryQuestDef.letterText: Your declaration shattered the uneasy peace inside the Institute and the Brotherhood alike. Over a low-band emergency frequency, {GIVER} has slipped a coded message past their commanders:\n\n"Maxson and Justin Ayo are preparing a total purge—no prisoners, no mercy. Not all of us signed on for slaughter. Keep your comms open for our breakout signals; if you help us escape, we'll bring everything we know to your colony."

li.label: Answering the dissenters
li.text: You can reply on the encrypted burst frequency to coordinate extraction windows with sympathetic officers and scientists inside the Brotherhood and Institute.

li.label: Broadcast safe-passage codes and pledge shelter to all defecting heroes
li.resultText: A brief double-click confirms receipt on the other end. The defection quests for the Brotherhood and Institute are ready to trigger as soon as their operatives make their move.

li.label: Ask them to smuggle out technical data and spare parts when they run
li.resultText: "Understood," the encrypted voice whispers before cutting out. "Keep a landing pad clear."

TurboMegaMod.StoryQuestDef.label: secret letters: wings and sulfur
TurboMegaMod.StoryQuestDef.letterLabel: A warning written in ash and ozone
TurboMegaMod.StoryQuestDef.letterText: Two wildly different messengers leave warnings at your perimeter within the same hour: a feather scorched by celestial fire from {GIVER}, and a sulfur-smudged note bearing Crowley's seal.\n\nHeaven's archangels are mobilizing execution squads against their own rebels, while Hell's fanatics are cracking the locks on Lucifer's Cage. Both dissenters warn that when the coups erupt, they will turn to {COLONY} for sanctuary.

li.label: Preparing for celestial and infernal exiles
li.text: The war between Heaven and Hell is spilling directly onto your doorstep. How do you prepare your settlement for incoming supernatural defectors?

li.label: Prepare Enochian wards and guest quarters for Castiel or Crowley
li.resultText: Your ward-smiths carve protective sigils into the gateposts—allowing rebel angels or a fugitive King of Hell to enter without triggering your traps.

li.label: Stockpile rock salt and silver in case their pursuers follow them home
li.resultText: Your armory crates are stacked with consecrated salt and silver—you will be ready when the hunters of Heaven and Hell arrive.

TurboMegaMod.StoryQuestDef.label: secret letters: cracks in the consortium
TurboMegaMod.StoryQuestDef.letterLabel: A cipher from inside the vaults
TurboMegaMod.StoryQuestDef.letterText: Your public stance has triggered a quiet mutiny inside the Consortium's outer ranks. {GIVER} transmits a frantic, half-burned cipher confirming that Dr. Hess, Dr. Braun, and Dick Roman are accelerating their harvest—and that dissenters inside Vault-Tec, the Outcasts, and the Men of Letters are ready to defect with the chemical key to Leviathan invulnerability.

li.label: Coordinating the inner-circle breakout
li.text: The Consortium's own archivists and overseers want out before the Blood Eclipse locks the doors forever.

li.label: Assign scouts to watch the borders for escaping archivists and overseers
li.resultText: Your perimeter lookouts are briefed on the dissenters' recognition signals. As soon as any of them join your colony, you will have the minds needed to crack the Borax formula.

li.label: Urge them to prioritize smuggling out the Leviathan containment files
li.resultText: "Already stuffed in my coat pocket," the coded reply flashes back. "Just keep the back gate unlocked."

li.label: Cross-referencing the defectors' intel
li.text: Your newly recruited defectors gather around {COLONY}'s research terminal, comparing their stolen faction archives against Sector 4 of the Holodisk-Key. Within hours, a breakthrough emerges: the exact chemical catalyst—concentrated sodium borate—needed to strip Leviathans and Dick Roman of their invulnerability, stored at a nearby SucroCorp annex.

li.label: Borax catalyst drums secured
li.text: Your squad fought past Leviathan guards at the SucroCorp annex and hauled back intact drums of concentrated sodium borate along with pre-war industrial alloys!

li.label: Synthesized from lab notes
li.text: Though Consortium sweepers torched the annex before your team arrived, your defectors successfully reconstructed the Borax sprayer formula from the Holodisk-Key's chemical equations.

li.label: Emergency chemical synthesis
li.text: Forced to retreat from the annex under heavy fire, your researchers still managed to synthesize the Borax weapon formula from salvaged sample vials.

li.label: Weaponizing the formula
li.text: In your workshop, the caustic white Borax solution is stabilized and loaded into pressurized sprayers and automated turret canisters—while the final harmonic schematics for the Spark Resonator compile on your main screen.

li.label: Prioritize Borax sprayers and turret blueprints for immediate defense
li.resultText: Your machinists lock the Borax sprayer and Borax turret schematics into your production benches. Leviathans will no longer be untouchable at your gates.

li.label: Sync the Borax formula with the Spark Resonator's harmonic blueprints
li.resultText: Both the Borax defense schematics and the Spark Resonator assembly list are finalized, ready for final construction.

li.label: Borax Formula & Resonator Blueprints Ready
li.text: Your researchers have unlocked the Borax Sprayer and Borax Turret schematics! With the anti-Leviathan countermeasure ready, it is time to gather the final materials and assemble the Spark Resonator.

li.label: Resonator frame forged
li.text: Your engineers have machined the plasteel containment housing for the Spark Resonator. Next, allocate pre-war gold for the Enochian conductive filaments.

li.label: Salvaged frame improvised
li.text: Running short on time, your mechanics welded salvaged Zero Anchor plating to form the housing, moving directly to the conductive gold filaments.

li.label: Enochian filaments inlaid
li.text: Fine gold circuitry has been etched into the Resonator's rings, bridging pre-war quantum physics with ancient celestial wards.

li.label: Thin-plated conduits
li.text: Your smiths stretched every spare gold shaving into razor-thin filaments to complete the circuit before the deadline.

li.label: Harmonic tuning
li.text: Before installing the final control components, the Zero Synth must attune the Resonator's central crystal to their own spiritual frequency. How do you guide the calibration?

li.label: Run a slow, painless resonance sync with the Zero Synth
li.resultText: Soft blue light pulses smoothly through the gold filaments without straining the Zero Synth. The crystal sings with a clear, steady tone.

li.label: Push maximum power through the crystal to maximize output
li.resultText: Lightning arcs violently across the frame as the crystal locks into high-output mode, leaving the Zero Synth pale and breathless.

li.label: Control console wired
li.text: The final industrial components are locked into place. The Spark Resonator is ready to be anchored into its permanent position.

li.label: Jury-rigged console complete
li.text: Using salvaged relay boards from the bunker, your technicians wired the final console just in time for placement.

li.label: Anchoring the Spark Resonator
li.text: The Spark Resonator stands complete, humming with enough power to rewrite the fate of Earth. Where will you anchor the machine before activating its main console?

li.label: Lower it directly into the opened Zero Anchor shaft beneath {COLONY}
li.resultText: Heavy winches lower the Resonator into the ancient subterranean chamber, locking it directly onto the continental ley-line core.

li.label: Mount it in the fortified heart of {COLONY}'s central keep
li.resultText: Heavy power conduits link the Resonator through the floor to the Anchor below, placing the console right where all your defenders and turrets can cover it.

li.label: Seal it inside an Enochian-warded sanctuary chamber to mask its pulse
li.resultText: Surrounded by carved silver wards, the Resonator hums quietly out of sight—shielded from stray psychic interference until the moment of reckoning.

li.label: Act IV: The Blood Eclipse
li.text: As the Spark Resonator locks into place, a blinding column of blue light pierces the clouds—and the sun above the wasteland turns a deep, ominous crimson. The Blood Eclipse has begun! Every faction leader is marching toward your console for Point of No Return #2.
